cinder_thread.name: Cinder Thread
cinder_thread.action: A narrow fire projectile. Restore 3 mana when it hits a living enemy.
cinder_thread.motif: fire needle and taut red thread

glacial_stitch.name: Glacial Stitch
glacial_stitch.action: Pierce up to 3 enemies and slow 30% for 2s. Two hits within 6s freeze briefly; elites resist the duration.
glacial_stitch.motif: long ice needle across jagged shards

arcane_fold.name: Arcane Fold
arcane_fold.action: Blink up to 4 ground units onto valid floor. Invalid destinations do not spend mana or cooldown.

ashen_ward.name: Ashen Ward
ashen_ward.action: Absorb incoming damage for 3s. This active ward does not heal or stack with itself.

starfall_script.name: Starfall Script
starfall_script.action: Cast for 0.3s, then mark a circle that strikes after another 0.8s. Damage snapshots on activation.

solar_writ.name: Solar Writ
solar_writ.action: A committed fire wave leaves a 3s burn. Direct damage and burn use the same spell-power snapshot.
solar_writ.motif: bronze sun seal and flame rays

winter_crown.name: Winter Crown
winter_crown.action: A freezing nova stuns for 1s. Elite control duration is halved.

epoch_lance.name: Epoch Lance
epoch_lance.action: A precise arcane lance pierces up to 3 enemies; each takes one hit.

echo_strike.name: Echo Strike
echo_strike.action: A recovered memory strikes after 0.6s. Reach: 7 ground units.

frost_ring.name: Winterglass Pulse
frost_ring.action: A cold pulse stuns nearby enemies for 1.2s.
frost_ring.motif: ice crystal and broken pulse ring

ember_cone.name: Cinderwake
ember_cone.action: A Lorecasting training technique: scorch a cone and burn for 3s.

dawnfall.name: Dawnfall
dawnfall.action: A large delayed radiant strike at the cursor. Reach: 7 units.
dawnfall.motif: gold pillar and fractured impact slabs

slash.name: Slash
slash.action: A swift sword strike. Restores 4 mana on the first successful hit.
slash.motif: broad steel sword and leather grip

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.action: A sweeping blow that strikes all enemies in front of you.
cleave.motif: heavy curved blade and slash crescent

charge.name: Shield Charge
charge.action: Charge toward the cursor, bashing every enemy in your path.
charge.motif: oversized iron shield, leather and momentum marks

rally.name: Rallying Cry
rally.action: Restore 25% HP and gain 30% damage for 6s.

hammer.name: Sundering Standard
hammer.action: A delayed standard strike at the cursor.
hammer.motif: navy/gold banner, iron pole and fractured slabs

harvest.name: Citadel Reprisal
harvest.action: Repel enemies and recover 4% life per target hit.
harvest.motif: frontal brass shield and outward arrows

breath.name: Furnace Sweep
breath.action: Sweep a fiery cone; burn for three seconds.

ember_aura.name: Ember Aura
ember_aura.action: Toggle a paid fire aura around the Mage; visual variant of Ashen Ward.
ember_aura.motif: rear-view navy/gold mage and fire ring
